title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Hierarchical nanocrystal aerogels combine a macroscopic interconnected porous network with deliberately engineered nanoscale backbone structures.
explanation: Using shape-controlled building blocks or post-gel modification can transfer hollow, dendritic, alloyed, or core–shell nanocrystal features into a monolithic aerogel.
conditions: The fine structure must survive assembly or be introduced after gel formation.
caveats: Surfactants needed to make complex nanocrystals can obstruct destabilization and gelation; scalable routes and gelation mechanisms remain unresolved.
